intro.text: The power that magic systems draw upon. An art may use Investiture from within the practitioner or from an outside source.
A form of power that, like matter, can be turned into energy. Magic systems are the most common way to tap it.

description.text: Invested Arts can gain Investiture, lose it or break even in use.
In the Physical Realm Investiture can take solid, liquid or gaseous forms, and solid Investiture is always metallic.
Investiture cannot be created or destroyed, only changed in form.
Raw Investiture responds to the thoughts and perceptions of thinking beings and can be reshaped by them, though a being with a firm sense of self resists such change.
Investiture in active use is called kinetic; Investiture held in a vessel such as a gemstone is static, and objects holding it resist being affected by Invested Arts.
